Noah Reed: Quick kickoff for VeloxAI migration POC. Customer wants route parity, streaming envelopes, and pricing guardrails. Can we assign owners?
Priya Rao: I'll own prompt parity + acceptance criteria. Aim: 600 canonical prompts across 6 intents.
Ibrahim Khan: I'll build a compat shim that accepts Velox-style POSTs and proxies to Redwood. Will emulate both SSE streaming and poll 202 flows.
Sophie Li: I'll answer security questionnaire (TLS, KMS, audit logs). Please share any residency constraints.
Evan Park: For pricing, propose $6k trial credit + alerts and a soft throttle at 6 RPS. Sales Ops to confirm.
sec-bot: Questionnaire: https://redwood-internal/poqs/velox-2026 - status: unfilled.
Priya Rao: Draft acceptance: top-1 exact >=80% after normalization OR semantic similarity >=0.9; median 256-token latency <170ms; streaming order preserved 99%.
Ibrahim Khan: Will push shim to registry: registry.redwood/staging/velox-compat:v0.1 and post curl examples for stream & poll.
Sophie Li: Uploaded initial answers, left 2 infra TODOs for KMS & webhook IP ranges.
Noah Reed: Action items: Ibrahim push shim; Priya run harness after shim up; Sophie finish questionnaire; Evan finalize trial credit. Kickoff Wed pending legal sign-off.
note: Sales presales Slack thread coordinating VeloxAI->Redwood compatibility POC: owners, shim plan, acceptance thresholds, security questionnaire, and trial credit discussion
